key_findings.reproduction_status: All 6 subsequent runs are exact duplicates of Run 1 baseline.
key_findings.executed_vs_configured: 6 base models + 3 ensembles configured and 100% executed in all 7 runs.
key_findings.leakage_assessment: No data leakage between train/val/test splits. Leakage-safe preprocessing was fit strictly on train set.
key_findings.overfitting_assessment: Severe overfitting observed (Train ROC-AUC >0.99 vs Val ROC-AUC 0.68-0.73 and Test ROC-AUC 0.63). Class imbalance caused models to default to predicting Control class.

recommended_next_experiments: Apply class-weight balancing (class_weight='balanced' or SMOTE) to fix 0% ADHD recall on validation.
Perform feature selection tuning (test k=25, 50, 200, 500 or ElasticNet/Lasso penalty).
Increase regularization parameters (lower C in SVM/Logistic Regression, max_depth <= 3 in Tree models) to prevent overfit.
Implement Leave-One-Site-Out Cross Validation for more robust out-of-site generalization.
